video.title: Sheet, Full Screen Cover & Presentation Detent | Day 143
video.description:
Learn to explain how to present a screen over another in SwiftUI: Sheet, Full Screen Cover & Presentation Detent, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Sheet - A screen that slides up over the current one, and the user can swipe it down.
Full Screen Cover - A screen that slides up and covers the whole screen, with no swipe to close.
Presentation Detent - A height that a sheet can stop at, such as medium or large.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Sheet, Full Screen Cover & Presentation Detent | Day 143
landscape.description:
Explain Sheet, Full Screen Cover & Presentation Detent in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
시트, 풀 스크린 커버, 프레젠테이션 디텐트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Sheet - A screen that slides up over the current one, and the user can swipe it down.
한국어: 시트: 현재 화면 위로 올라오고 사용자가 아래로 밀어 닫을 수 있는 화면

Full Screen Cover - A screen that slides up and covers the whole screen, with no swipe to close.
한국어: 풀 스크린 커버: 올라와서 화면 전체를 덮고, 밀어서 닫을 수 없는 화면

Presentation Detent - A height that a sheet can stop at, such as medium or large.
한국어: 프레젠테이션 디텐트: 시트가 멈출 수 있는 높이. 예를 들어 중간이나 크게

landscape.hook: Can you explain Sheet, Full Screen Cover and Presentation Detent in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want the note editor to slide up from the bottom.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Sheet. It slides up over the current screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The user can still see the screen behind it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and they can swipe the Sheet down to close it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I want a login screen that covers everything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Full Screen Cover. It covers the whole screen, and there is no swipe to close.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then how does the user close a Full Screen Cover?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You need a Button that dismisses it. Do not forget that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My Sheet is too tall. It hides the whole list.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Presentation Detent. Use `.medium`, and the Sheet stops at half height.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the user still pull it up?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. With `.medium` and `.large` in the code, the Presentation Detent has two stops.
